intro: With Lakeshire under pressure from hostile forces, town maintenance and defense rely entirely on local labor. Foreman Oslow's essential tools, shipped from Goldshire, were lost when Blackrock catapult fire sank his transport boat into Lake Everstill. Retrieving the sunken chest from the lakebed is critical to rebuilding the town's shattered bridge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I could really use a hand here, friend. With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies. My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out. We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult. Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.
Retrieve my toolbox, friend, and I'll make it worth your while.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find my tools?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent recovery, friend! I never thought I'd see these tools again.
